title: Farkle - Kingdom Come Delivrance
description: This project add a working Farkle Dice game inspired of Kingdom Come Delivrance
body:
## Farkle Dice Game

Bring tavern gambling into Minecraft with **Farkle Dice Game**, a Fabric mod that lets you challenge villagers to a full game of **Farkle** using **Amethyst Shards** as your wager.

Face off against villagers in a custom dice UI, manage risky rerolls, bank points at the right time, and try to beat your opponent to the target score before your luck runs out. If a villager is out of shards, the interaction shifts into a small **pawnshop system**, giving the mod a simple economy loop instead of just a dead end.

### What this mod adds
- Play **Farkle** directly against villagers
- Bet **Amethyst Shards** on each match
- Open the game from villager interaction or the trade screen
- Villagers have their own **persistent purse**
- **Pawnshop menu** when a villager is broke
- Optional **PvP challenge command**
- **English and French** support with:
  - `/farkle lang us`
  - `/farkle lang fr`

### How it feels
This mod is designed to feel like a small side activity you would find in a tavern or market square: quick to start, easy to understand, and dangerous if you get greedy.
